questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the divided roadway is ending. You are about to enter a two-way highway where traffic flows in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Vehicles that move slowly display this sign to alert other drivers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you cannot turn right or left when the traffic light is red. You must wait for a green light to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mean you are in or near a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and obey the posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guards signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign warns you that a school is nearby. Be ready to stop if you see children crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you the road splits ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves to the right, then curves to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic from another road will soon merge into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road direction is changing or the road is getting narrower. You may see these signs on sharp curves or at narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions ahead. Speed advisory plaques on these signs show the recommended safe speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers near schools. It tells you to slow down, drive carefully, and look for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead is divided by an island or barrier. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed limit.
The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
You must not travel below the speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum speed allowed. You can drive slower if road conditions require it, but you cannot drive faster than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
May not proceed until it changes to green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Come to a complete stop at the stop line or before the crosswalk. Yield to all other traffic and pedestrians before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign (yellow with black markings) tells you your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. Stop at a point where you can see any oncoming traffic before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should slow down and move to the right lane.
Stay in the right lane if you are driving more slowly than other traffic.
Slower traffic must exit on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the right lane if you are driving more slowly than other traffic.
questions.explanation: This white rectangular sign is a traffic rule. It means keep the left lane open for passing and faster traffic when you are driving slowly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign (yellow with black markings) alerts you to conditions ahead. It warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: You must yield the right-of-way at this sign. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross your path first. Stop if necessary before going ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You may see this sign at intersections where oncoming traffic makes U-turns unsafe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep or long downgrade or hill ahead. The hill may have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions just ahead. This sign warns you of an upcoming winding road with curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign alerts drivers to school zones. This sign warns that children and pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on a vehicle means it travels at slow speeds. You may see this on farm equipment, construction vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. During the day it looks like a solid orange triangle, and at night it appears as a hollow red triangle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May turn left only on a green arrow.
May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
Must wait for the solid green light before you turn left.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A "yield" sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop for vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians. After letting them pass, you may follow the remaining directions on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that a divided highway is beginning and you should stay on the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Bicyclists use hand and arm signals because bicycles don't have turn signals. When a bicyclist extends their left arm straight out, they are signaling a left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangular sign is always a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop when you see this sign.
